newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Challenge promotes Andrews to ceo.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Challenge promotes Andrews to ceo.

text.p: Hugh Fletcher, the chief executive of Fletcher Challenge Limited, holding company of several New Zealand-based industrial and energy companies, is to retire after ten years in the post, the company said on Wednesday.
In a statement it said executive director Michael Andrews would be promoted to the chief executive role when Fletcher retired on December 14 this year.

Fletcher Challenge chairman Bill Wilson said the appointment followed "an intensive international search process and the subsequent evaluation of current Fletcher Challenge executives and more than 50 external candidates".
Andrews, who has been an executive director since 1990, has 27 years experience in the group and is currently chief executive of Fletcher Challenge Energy and Forests.
The two other listed operating entities are Fletcher Building and Fletcher Paper.
